51600-the-border-boys-along-the-st-lawre.creator: Hurst & Company
51600-the-border-boys-along-the-st-lawre.description: A book by Hurst & Company. “All right,” responded Ralph Stetson from his position at the steering wheel of the swift motor boat the _River Swallow_, “I saw them ten minutes ago, Hardware. Just give Persimmons down below a hail and tell him to slow up a bit. They’re wild waters and we don’t want to go through them too fast.”

arxiv-2107-14192.title: Compatibility aspects of the method of phase synchronization for decoupling linear second-order differential equations
arxiv-2107-14192.creator: W. Sarlet, T. Mestdag, [2mm] Department of Mathematics, Ghent University Krijgslaan 281, 9000 Ghent, Belgium, [2mm] Department of Mathematics, University of Antwerp,Middelheimlaan 1, 2020 Antwerpen, Belgium [2mm] Email: willy.sarlet@ugent.be, tom.mestdag@uantwerpen.be
arxiv-2107-14192.description: Abstract Abstract. The so-called method of phase synchronization has been advocated in a number of papers as a way of decoupling a system of linear second-order differential equations by a linear transformation of coordinates and velocities. This is a rather unusual approach because velocity-dependent transformations in general do not preserve the second-order character of differential equations.

arxiv-2202-00494.title: Optimal Decision Theory for Diagnostic Testing: Minimizing Indeterminate Classes with Applications to Saliva-Based SARS-CoV-2 Antibody Assays
arxiv-2202-00494.creator: Paul N. Patrone 1, Prajakta Bedekar 1,2, Nora Pisanic 3, Yukari C. Manabe 4, David L. Thomas 4, Christopher D. Heaney 3, Anthony J. Kearsley 1
arxiv-2202-00494.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Paul N. Patrone 1, Prajakta Bedekar 1,2, Nora Pisanic 3, Yukari C. Manabe 4, David L. Thomas 4, Christopher D. Heaney 3, Anthony J. Kearsley 1. In diagnostic testing, establishing an indeterminate class is an effective way to identify samples that cannot be accurately classified. However, such approaches also make testing less efficient and must be balanced against overall assay performance.

arxiv-2206-01703.title: Interactive Exploration of Large Dendrograms with Prototypes
arxiv-2206-01703.creator: Andee Kaplan
arxiv-2206-01703.description: Abstract Hierarchical clustering is one of the standard methods taught for identifying and exploring the underlying structures that may be present within a data set. Students are shown examples in which the dendrogram, a visual representation of the hierarchical clustering, reveals a clear clustering structure.

arxiv-2207-13006.title: Dynamics Near a Photonic Band-Edge: Strong Coupling Effects Beyond Rotating-Wave Approximation
arxiv-2207-13006.creator: Matthieu Vanhoecke, 1 Orazio Scarlatella, 2 and Marco Schirò 1
arxiv-2207-13006.description: Abstract We study the dynamics of a quantum emitter coupled to a two-dimensional photonic crystal featuring a finite bandwidth with sharp edges and a Van-Hove singularity. We study the effect of strong system-bath coupling and non-Markovianity of the photonic environment using a non-perturbative approach based on the recently introduced NCA dynamical map for open quantum systems.

arxiv-2211-06496.title: Depth and Representation in Vision Models
arxiv-2211-06496.creator: Benjamin L. Badger
arxiv-2211-06496.description: Abstract Deep learning models develop successive representations of their input in sequential layers, the last of which maps the final representation to the output. Here we investigate the informational content of these representations by observing the ability of convolutional image classification models to autoencode the model’s input using embeddings existing in various layers.

arxiv-2406-14839.title: Augmenting Human Expertise in Weighted Ensemble Simulations through Deep Learning based Information Bottleneck
arxiv-2406-14839.creator: Dedi Wang, Pratyush Tiwary
arxiv-2406-14839.description: Abstract The weighted ensemble (WE) method stands out as a widely used segment-based sampling technique renowned for its rigorous treatment of kinetics. The WE framework typically involves initially mapping the configuration space onto a low-dimensional collective variable (CV) space and then partitioning it into bins. The efficacy of WE simulations heavily depends on the selection of CVs and binning schemes.

arxiv-2410-18838.title: Phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo method for cavity-QED matter systems
arxiv-2410-18838.creator: Lukas Weber, Leonardo dos Anjos Cunha, Miguel A. Morales, Angel Rubio, Shiwei Zhang
arxiv-2410-18838.description: Abstract Abstract We present a generalization of the phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (AFQMC) method to cavity quantum-electrodynamical (QED) matter systems. The method can be formulated in both the Coulomb and the dipole gauge. We verify its accuracy by benchmarking calculations on a set of small molecules against full configuration interaction and state-of-the-art QED coupled cluster (QED-CCSD) calculations.

arxiv-2506-08963.title: Evaluating Generative Vehicle Trajectory Models for Traffic Intersection Dynamics
arxiv-2506-08963.creator: Yash Ranjan, Rahul Sengupta, Anand Rangarajan, Sanjay Ranka
arxiv-2506-08963.description: Abstract Traffic Intersections are vital to urban road networks as they regulate the movement of people and goods. However, they are regions of conflicting trajectories and are prone to accidents. Deep Generative models of traffic dynamics at signalized intersections can greatly help traffic authorities better understand the efficiency and safety aspects.

arxiv-2507-23613.title: A Multi-Frequency Helmholtz Solver Based on the WaveHoltz Algorithm
arxiv-2507-23613.creator: Daniel Appelö, Francis Appiah, Jeffrey W. Banks, Cassandra Carrick, William D. Henshaw, Donald W. Schwendeman
arxiv-2507-23613.description: Abstract We develop and analyze a new approach for simultaneously computing multiple solutions to the Helmholtz equation for different frequencies and different forcing functions. The new Multi-Frequency WaveHoltz (MFWH) algorithm is an extension of the original WaveHoltz method and both are based on time-filtering solutions to an associated wave equation.

arxiv-2508-02156.title: Spherically Symmetric, Static Solutions in Presence of Matter-Curvature Coupling
arxiv-2508-02156.creator: Debanjan Debnath, Kaushik Bhattacharya
arxiv-2508-02156.description: Abstract In this work we have proposed some spherically symmetric, static spacetimes in a theory of gravity which permits non-minimal coupling (NMC) between curvature of spacetime and fluid variables. It is shown that these non-minimally coupled theories may admit of new class of metric solutions.

arxiv-2511-18513.title: LRDUN: A Low-Rank Deep Unfolding Network for Efficient Spectral Compressive Imaging
arxiv-2511-18513.creator: He Huang, Yujun Guo, Wei He, yujunguo@whu.edu.cn, weihe1990@whu.edu.cn
arxiv-2511-18513.description: Abstract Deep unfolding networks (DUNs) have achieved remarkable success and become the mainstream paradigm for spectral compressive imaging (SCI) reconstruction. Existing DUNs are derived from full-HSI imaging models, where each stage operates directly on the high-dimensional HSI, refining the entire data cube based on the single 2D coded measurement.

arxiv-2511-21504.title: Analytic First-Order Entanglement Entropy of Schwarzschild Black Holes with Interacting Scalars
arxiv-2511-21504.creator: Florin Manea
arxiv-2511-21504.description: Abstract Abstract: We compute the first-order correction to the entanglement entropy of a scalar field with quartic self-interaction across the horizon of a Schwarzschild black hole. The main novelty of this work is the derivation of a fully explicit analytic expression for both the renormalized Newton’s constant, G_{F} , and the corresponding entropy correction, \delta S^{(1)} .

arxiv-2602-14925.title: [C/N] Ages and Extra-Mixing for [Fe/H] < ⁣ − <- 0.5: Insights from the LMC and SMC Facilities: Gaia ( 17 ; 16 ) , 2MASS ( 45 ) , APOGEE–2S ( 49 ) , Kepler ( 6 ) astropy ( 5 ; 39 ; 4 ) , Matplotlib ( 23 ) , NumPy ( 21 ) , Pandas ( 31 ) , ChatGPT ( 35 )
arxiv-2602-14925.creator: Yuxi(Lucy) Lu, John D Roberts, Joshua T. Povick, Marc H. Pinsonneault, Madeline Howell, David L. Nidever, Jennifer A. Johnson
arxiv-2602-14925.description: Abstract The [C/N]–age relation has become a powerful tool for reconstructing the formation history of the Milky Way (MW), providing the largest age sample for field giant stars. However, at metallicities below [Fe/H] < − 0.5 <-0.5 , stellar surfaces are altered by a poorly understood process known as extra mixing, which modifies [C/N] in a mass- and metallicity-dependent manner.

europmc-pmc10304137.title: Epidemiology, Risk Factors, and Prevention of Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
europmc-pmc10304137.creator: Barsouk A, Aluru JS, Rawla P, Saginala K, Barsouk A.
europmc-pmc10304137.description: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is a group of malignancies, involving the oral cavity, pharynx, hypopharynx, larynx, nasal cavity, and salivary glands, that together compose the seventh most common cancer diagnosis worldwide. With 890,000 new cases and 450,000...

pmc-10644113.title: Antibiotic-Dispensing Patterns and Awareness of Anti-microbial Resistance Among the Community Pharmacists in South-Central India
pmc-10644113.creator: Moturu Dharanindra, Krishna Shriram Dhanasekaran, Supriya Rayana, Shaik Mohammad Noor, Piyush Bandela, Rudrapaka Pavan Sri Viswanadh, Kalva Hemanth Kumar
pmc-10644113.description: BackgroundAnti-microbial resistance (AMR) is an ongoing epidemic contributing to extremely high healthcare costs and hospital admissions. Inappropriate dispensing of antibiotics is one of the root causes of AMR. Hence, our study aimed to assess antibiotic-dispensing patterns and AMR awareness among pharmacists from South-Central India.MethodologyThis cross-sectional observational study was conducted over a period of two months from June to July 2023.

pmc-10647585.title: Guijing2501 (Citrus unshiu) Has Stronger Cold Tolerance Due to Higher Photoprotective Capacity as Revealed by Comparative Transcriptomic and Physiological Analysis and Overexpression of Early Light-Induced Protein
pmc-10647585.creator: Cui Xiao, Ligang He, Wenming Qiu, Zeqiong Wang, Xiujuan He, Yuxiong Xiao, Zhonghai Sun, Zhu Tong, Yingchun Jiang
pmc-10647585.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Cold is one of the major limiting factors for citrus production, particularly extreme cold waves. Therefore, it is of great importance to develop cold-tolerant varieties and clarify their cold tolerance mechanisms in citrus breeding. In this study, comparative transcriptomic and physiological analyses were performed to dissect the cold tolerance mechanism of Guijing2501 (GJ2501), a new satsuma mandarin (Citrus unshiu) variety with about 1 °C lower LT50 (the median lethal temperature) relative to Guijing (GJ).

pmc-11451174.title: Utilizing radiomics techniques to isolate a single vertebral body from chest CT for opportunistic osteoporosis screening
pmc-11451174.creator: Xiaocong Lin, Rongkai Shen, Xiaoling Zheng, Shaojian Shi, Zhangsheng Dai, Kaibin Fang
pmc-11451174.description: PurposeOpportunistic osteoporosis screening, conducted during routine medical examinations such as chest computed tomography (CT), presents a potential solution for early detection. This study aims to investigate the feasibility of utilizing radiomics technology based on chest CT images to screen for opportunistic osteoporosis.MethodsThis Study is a Multicenter Retrospective Investigation.

pmc-11612353.title: The effectiveness of an intervention using LAWE (loveliness and well-being of employees) app to improve the employee’s mental well-being
pmc-11612353.creator: Mohammad Ali Morowatisharifabad, Abedin Iranpour, Mohammadreza Rajabalipour
pmc-11612353.description: Background: Organizations are increasingly seeking comprehensive approaches to improve employee mental well-being (EMW). This study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of interventions delivered through the "Loveliness and Well-being of Employees" (LAWE) app, focusing on five key predictors: "Keep Learning," "Connect," "Take Notice," "Be Active," and "Given".

pmc-12590689.title: Gaza’s health emergency: impact of armed conflict and its global health repercussions
pmc-12590689.creator: Majid Ali, Inayat Ur Rehman, Kah Seng Lee, Long Chiau Ming
pmc-12590689.description: The Gaza Strip, characterized by its dense population and persistent geopolitical instability, has experienced decades of armed conflict, resulting in systematic healthcare infrastructure deterioration. The healthcare delivery system has been collapsed by Israeli military operations, creating cascading effects that extend beyond regional boundaries.

pmc-12611027.title: Neurodevelopmental Changes in the Guinea Pig Brain Caused by Time-Limited Complete Vitamin C Deprivation
pmc-12611027.creator: Ivan Čapo, Ilija Andrijević, Nataša Čapo, Milan Popović, Ivan Milenković, Radomir Ratajac, Dejan Vranješ, Dragana Milutinović, Dragana Simin, Slobodan Sekulić
pmc-12611027.description: Background/Objectives: The guinea pig is a unique experimental model because of the evolutionary loss of the GULO gene, which encodes an enzyme involved in vitamin C synthesis. Since vitamin C plays an essential role in collagen biochemistry, numerous studies have investigated the effects of pre- and postnatal vitamin C deficiency.

pmc-12691261.title: The Impact of MEI1 Alternative Splicing Events on Spermatogenesis in Mongolian Horses
pmc-12691261.creator: Dailing Song, Guoqing Wang, Terigele Baterin, Yajuan Weng, Manglai Dugarjaviin, Bei Li, Laura Patterson Rosa
pmc-12691261.description: Simple SummaryThis study examines how two forms of the MEI1 gene—exon skipping (SE, omitting a gene segment) and mutually exclusive exons (MXE, selecting one of two exons)—affect sperm production in Mongolian horses. Using viral carriers, we introduced these splicing types into Sertoli cells (SCs) and found that SE-type MEI1 showed higher expression than MXE-type (p < 0.001).

pmc-12743687.title: Characteristics of children born to mothers with an anorectal malformation
pmc-12743687.creator: Joshua Gertler, Anna Gunnarsdóttir, Jenny Oddsberg, Anna Svenningsson, Lisa Örtqvist, Anna Löf Granström, Tomas Wester
pmc-12743687.description: PurposeTo describe characteristics of offspring born to mothers having an anorectal malformation (ARM).MethodsThis was a national population-based cohort study. The exposed group was the offspring of females with an ARM diagnosis (ICD-codes) in the Swedish National Patient Register 1964–2008. The unexposed group was the offspring of mothers without ARM.

pmc-13478418.title: Prenatal depression increases the odds of preterm birth in a prospective cohort study in Hangzhou
pmc-13478418.creator: Lulu Zhai, Chunchun Fang, Luning Wang, Jianqin Tan
pmc-13478418.description: There is little evidence about the susceptible exposure window of maternal depression during pregnancy and preterm birth in China. We aimed to assess the trimester-specific association of depression during pregnancy with preterm birth, and the effect modification of social support. In 2021–2023, a prospective cohort study was conducted in Hangzhou, China.

pmc-13573698.title: Case report of a brain abscess due to Nannizziopsis obscura species complex in a renal transplanted patient
pmc-13573698.creator: Othman Mounir Alaoui, Astrid De Liège, Frédéric Mechai, Dea Garcia-Hermoso, Fanny Lanternier, Bertrand Degos
pmc-13573698.description: We here describe the case of a kidney transplant patient from Mali who presented with multiple complex seizures followed by a facial paresis revealing a brain abscess due to Nannizziopsis obscura species complex. This fungal species is usually implicated in reptile skin infections and rarely disseminated infections.

uslaw-usc-t19-s240.title: 19 U.S.C. § 240 — Value at date of shipment
uslaw-usc-t19-s240.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t19-s240.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 3 (The Tariff And Related Provisions); Part 1 (Definitions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. When the duty upon any imports shall be subject to be levied upon the true market value of such imports in the principal markets of the country from whence the importation has been made, or at the port of exportation.
